I managed to break it (Don't get me wrong, this is awesome, I just like to break stuff).

When the network is not reliable, slow, then some requests are cancelled and other one mades. Overall at some point you find yourself in a state that is different from the last time you went to that state.

It happens with the empty query it seems.
